## Your context

A few sentences on the system you are working with: size, age,
deployment model, team structure. Enough to make the question
answerable.

## What you are trying to figure out

The specific question. Be as concrete as you can; "should I
extract this?" is harder to answer than "given these five signal
ratings and this driver, should I extract?".

## What you have already tried

If you have already looked at the whitepaper, a discipline guide,
or an outcome file, which one and what you found unclear.

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant.
